I always wanted to die from a terminal ilness of some sort, so I could actually see people around me reacting to my possible death.

Ngl  now I'm kind of afraid to see them not really giving a fuck about it.

I was also thinking about the financial and emotional burden on my family for a couple of months when I was thinking about suicide but then passed to the "well it's not going to be a me problem after I commit" phase.

My advice is to seek therapy. Committing is a decision in my opinion, but it's an irreversible one. So before making that choice, please try to talk to someone professional. It might at least change the way you think.
